therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Atezolizumab plus chemotherapy (carboplatin + gemcitabine or docetaxel)
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: PD-L1 immune checkpoint blockade combined with chemotherapy-induced immunogenic cell death
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Restoration of anti-tumor T-cell activity and enhancement of immune response through chemotherapy-induced antigen release
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Cisplatin-ineligible patients with advanced urothelial carcinoma who progressed on prior PD-1 or PD-L1 inhibitor

safety_signals: All 6 patients had grade 3+ adverse events
All 6 patients had grade 3+ treatment-related adverse events
results.dose_information: Atezolizumab 1,200 mg IV Day 1 of each 21 day cycle; Carboplatin AUC 4 IV Day 1 of each 21 day cycle; Gemcitabine 1,000 mg/m2 IV Day 1 and Day 8 of each 21 day cycle; Docetaxel 75 mg/m2 IV Day 1 of each 21 day cycle
